Topic 2.2.1: Painting MAKING TECHNIQUES

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Painting MAKING TECHNIQUES. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. perform free choice painting on paper for enjoyment
2. appreciate own and others painted work

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. perform free choice painting on paper for enjoyment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to perform free choice painting on paper for enjoyment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate own and others painted work
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate own and others painted work. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Painting MAKING TECHNIQUES.
2. Explain Painting MAKING TECHNIQUES to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Guide learners to select painting materials 3. What do you use MAKING leaner should be able to:
4. Show that you can: perform free choice painting on paper for enjoyment
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Painting MAKING TECHNIQUES. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Painting MAKING TECHNIQUES important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
